verdict.rationale: Perplexity's docs tell developers to install its official SDKs for a type-safe integration. The first-party perplexity-py GitHub library documents typed request/response definitions, sync and async clients, SSE streaming, automatic retries with backoff, and typed API errors. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install one of our official SDKs for a convenient, type-safe integration
The library includes type definitions for all request params and response fields, and offers both synchronous and asynchronous clients powered by httpx
We provide support for streaming responses using Server Side Events (SSE).
Certain errors are automatically retried 2 times by default, with a short exponential backoff.
